critical_governance: Contract/claim records support commercial administration and evidence management; the system does not autonomously make legal conclusions.
Binding notices, waivers, settlements, commitments and executed changes require authorized human approval/action.
Approved contract/change versions are immutable; superseding versions preserve prior states and audit history.
Notice deadlines and jurisdiction-specific rules are configurable and require source contract/jurisdiction basis.
AI outputs retain evidence/confidence and may assist clause extraction, notice finding, classification, backup review and risk analysis only.
Commercial values reconcile with finance/cost, schedule impacts, procurement/subcontracts and controlled documents.
